title: Prepending a safe computation step
statement: Let $H$ be a multi-tape machine with Boolean work tapes and state set $B$, let $\mathrm{avoid}\in B$, and let $c,c_1,c'$ be configurations on the same input. If one step of $H$ takes $c$ to $c_1$, the state of $c$ is not $\mathrm{avoid}$, and running $H$ from $c_1$ for $t$ steps reaches $c'$ without visiting state $\mathrm{avoid}$ at any time strictly before $t$, then running $H$ from $c$ for $t+1$ steps reaches $c'$ without visiting state $\mathrm{avoid}$ at any time strictly before $t+1$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean work-tape machine $H$ with state set $B$
A safe run from $c_1$ for $t$ steps ends at $c'$
